approach: Static recompilation of the game into native C, plus a runtime that reproduces the hardware, so no interpreter sits in the hot path.
help: Widescreen margin fidelity across later areas
Reverse engineering additional room and object systems
Playtesting Linux and Windows widescreen builds
notes: Public builds for Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64 (v0.6.1+), toolchain only: you supply your own copy of the game and no game data is distributed. Frame-exact against a cycle-accurate reference; 75 of 75 Blargg and Mooneye tests pass. Ships both the 256px widescreen remaster (cartridge RoomMap margins, margin room/cutscene actors, world props and shadows, centred overlays, mastered audio, GPU GLSL CRT-Lottes & GBC LCD shaders, linear-light LCD response) and the authentic 160px build. Android is planned.
